name: RedotPay Card
summary: RedotPay is a Hong Kong-based crypto card that lets you spend USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH and other assets wherever Visa is accepted. It has no monthly fee and a 1.2% FX fee, but it requires identity verification and is not available in the United States, mainland China and around 45 other restricted countries.

fees.topup: Crypto deposits free; 1% fee to convert crypto when spending

limits.dailySpend: You set it in the app (per card)
limits.atmWithdrawal: No fixed cap published (physical card only)

rewards.cashback: None on the free plan; 3% on Apple Pay/Google Pay purchases with RedotPay Pro (capped at US$18/month)

kyc.notes: Identity verification is mandatory and runs inside the app through Sumsub. Citizens of restricted countries cannot complete it.

pros: No monthly or annual card fee
Virtual card is issued instantly in the app for US$10
Spend USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH and other assets through Visa
You control per-transaction and daily limits per card
cons: Not available to US or mainland China residents, plus around 45 other restricted countries
1.2% FX fee plus a 1% crypto conversion fee
No cashback without the paid Pro membership

faq.question: Is RedotPay available in the United States?
faq.answer: No. US residents are on RedotPay's restricted list, along with mainland China, Russia, India, Indonesia, Singapore, Turkey and other countries. The full list is on the RedotPay available countries page.

faq.question: How much does the RedotPay card cost?
faq.answer: The virtual card costs US$10 and the physical card US$100, both one-off fees. There is no monthly or annual card fee.

faq.question: What are RedotPay's FX and ATM fees?
faq.answer: Purchases in a currency other than the card's currency carry a 1.2% fee, and converting crypto to spend carries a 1% fee. ATM withdrawals cost 2%, rising to 3% on the amount above US$10,000 in a month.

faq.question: Do I need to complete KYC to use RedotPay?
faq.answer: Yes. Identity verification is mandatory and is done inside the app through Sumsub before you can use the card.

faq.question: Does RedotPay work with Apple Pay and Google Pay?
faq.answer: Google Pay works. Since August 2025 new RedotPay cards cannot be added to Apple Pay; cards added before then keep working, but cannot be re-added if removed.

faq.question: Does RedotPay offer cashback?
faq.answer: Not on the free plan. RedotPay Pro (US$12.90/month or US$129/year) adds 3% cashback on Apple Pay and Google Pay purchases, capped at US$18 a month.

availabilityNotes: RedotPay publishes the countries it excludes rather than a list of supported ones. Residents of the restricted list cannot complete identity verification or be issued a card (RedotPay also lists Bouvet Island and the Netherlands Antilles). Physical cards additionally cannot be delivered to Egypt, Palestine or Tunisia, and the card cannot be used in sanctioned territories. The supported list here is every other country; RedotPay updates its lists, so confirm in the app before verifying.
howToGet: Download the RedotPay app and create an account.
Complete identity verification in the app (Sumsub ID check). Residents of restricted countries cannot verify.
Deposit crypto such as USDT or USDC to cover the card fee: US$10 for a virtual card or US$100 for a physical card.
Apply for the virtual card in the app, or order the physical card and confirm your delivery address.
Add the virtual card to Google Pay or start spending online. Set your per-transaction and daily limits under Card > Limit.
